# three-stops-open-end

Synthetic (search-map-routes.md §9.4 area). Home Chichester, open end, 09:00–18:00. Portsmouth is
fixed at 11:00 (window 10:55–11:10), Bognor has no agreed time, Littlehampton is "after 14:00".

Portsmouth first, then Bognor, then Littlehampton: 120 minutes of driving on the estimate matrix,
against about 150 for Bognor first (Bognor → Portsmouth → Littlehampton crosses the area twice).
Portsmouth is reached at 10:55, the window's start, so the departure from home is pushed to 10:11
rather than waiting at the seller's; Littlehampton likewise at 14:00 with the departure from
Bognor pushed to 13:40. Finish 14:10 (estimate; the router would give different minutes, not a
different order).
